scenes.headline: Which layer is your model reading?
scenes.body: Bronze, silver, gold. Three layers everyone can name and few can defend.

scenes.headline: Silver is where the meaning is fixed.
scenes.body: Types enforced, duplicates removed, entities conformed, quality gates applied. A model reading silver may assume shape, but not agreement.

scenes.headline: Which layer is your model reading?
scenes.body: Then: what does that layer guarantee, and what are you checking yourself. Teams that cannot answer the second half are trusting a promise nobody made.
